entries.84697cc37a4df440: This is a single segment that conducts business related to corporate real estate (CRE). It consists of the CRE solutions business, which uses in-house developed real estate tech systems, and the real estate tech business, which develops and sells real estate tech systems. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 is ¥2,555 million.

entries.ade37fa4853493fe: Real estate players such as real estate companies, asset management companies, financial institutions, construction companies and real estate survey companies
entries.c768d033760334cc: This business uses real estate tech systems to provide one-stop services covering CRE advisory, CRE fund formation, project management, real estate investment using balance sheets, real estate leasing and real estate brokerage. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥2,383 million, accounting for about 93% of total group revenue. Real estate leasing is conducted through factories and other properties held by consolidated subsidiary Kakamigahara Property Co., Ltd.
entries.cbc524d570fa276d: This business develops real estate tech systems such as the CRE sales support system “CCReB AI,” the commercial real estate matching system “CCReB CREMa,” and the BtoB portal site “CCReB GATEWAY,” and provides them to real estate players as subscription services and the like. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥171 million, accounting for about 7% of total group revenue. Planning, development and operation of the systems are handled by consolidated subsidiary CCReB Marketing Co., Ltd.
